text: Core IT solutions for credit providers | Bankish Solutions About us Insights News room Case studies Blog Partners Contacts Schedule a demo Solutions built around how real lenders operate Bankish is an end-to-end loan management platform that helps financial institutions launch, run, and scale credit products with full control. Our modular system supports every step of the lending lifecycle, from onboarding to repayments, and adapts to a wide range of lending models. SEE ALL FEATURES Easily onboard clients through multiple channels Applications can be submitted via a self-service portal, physical office, website, or API-integrated partner systems. New products can be created and configured quickly, enabling a fast go-to-market strategy Flexible risk decisionin Support for fully automated and manual underwriting flows. Integrates with third-party data providers for credit checks and scoring. Loan agreements are generated automatically through a configurable approval process with full API access. Smart contract management and customer interaction Contracts and client data are easy to manage and search. All communication is logged in a centralized module, with smooth interaction between internal teams and the self-service portal. Automated email/SMS notifications are built in, and payment handling supports both manual and automated processes. Keep overdue payments under control Automated reminders via SMS and email help reduce delinquency. Late fees and penalty interest are calculated automatically to streamline recovery efforts. Insights for compliance, control, and growth Automatically generate profit & loss statements, portfolio overviews, and regulatory reports. Customizable templates support both internal and external reporting needs, including FCA and other regulatory standards. Serving modern lenders with full portfolio flexibility Whether you’re offering SME credit, consumer loans, leasing, or deposits — Bankish supports your operations with scalable, modular software tailored to lending. Flexible products and scoring for all needs Become the go-to financier in your field with Bankish. Maintain full control over your portfolio in real-time, be it by offering bespoke solutions for your key accounts or launching a completely new product category altogether. Remain on top of risk management with Bankish’s built-in scoring – run designated models for each product and override calculations, if necessary. Built for lenders of every size, with full credit portfolio coverage Bankish supports a wide range of lending models, from secured and unsecured loans to SME credit, microfinance, leasing, and deposits. Whether you’re launching a single product or managing a complex portfolio, the platform adapts to your needs with flexible modules, smart automation, and real-time control. All your lending tools in one flexible, scalable platform Product management Full control over your entire portfolio, to the detail. Easily launch or amend products by defining them using drop-down menus – from schedule types to transaction orders, from min-max definitions to fees’ management. Loans Full functionality coverage for the entire credit spectrum, regardless of the type or function. Unsecured and secured, business and consumer credit – Bankish is a single tool to cover it all, from origination to reporting. Deposits Manage deposits or inbound investments with our deposit module functionality. With both time and demand deposit coverage, Bankish supports funding operations of any financial institution. CRM Bankish features a comprehensive integral CRM to help maintain control over the business. Other than maintaining customer profiles, communications and contracts, the functionality enables automated messaging as well as internal tasks. Scoring With Bankish’s integral scoring engine, you can run designated risk models for each of your products. If desired, pre-, personal and credit scoring can be run separately to save on operational costs. Payments Payouts and collections are managed and coordinated in Bankish, from where outbound payments are initiated and incoming payments are allocated – both ISO-standard payment slips as well as direct gateway requests. Arrears management Delays and overdues are managed in Bankish with instant overview of arrears, by contract, by customer or by product. With high-detail views and process automation, debt management is a breeze with Bankish. Regulatory compliance All data is secured in a dedicated server instance and can be withdrawn by Bankish’s integral reporting functionality. In addition to standard accounting and regulatory reports, Bankish features a powerful BI solution. Why choose Bankish for your core-IT? Modular software Tailored solutions for credit providers from our full functionality stack – use what you need and scale how you want, today and tomorrow. End-to-end coverage Full product spectrum and life cycles’ coverage makes Bankish’s implementation the last transformation project your business needs to tend to. SaaS approach Affordable software rent and maintenance guaranteed from day 1 – Pay-as-you-Grow pricing model means you pay more only when you earn more. Your one-stop-shop core-IT with the help of our partners Our software is deliberately focused on credit provision and deposits, without “inventing the wheel” in ID verification, PSD2 or card-provision services, for instance. Bankish has a vibrant partner ecosystem ensuring end-to-end delivery for all your needs, collectively forming a true one-stop-shop for financial institutions.
